Professional Summary
Frontend engineer focused on Vue ecosystem and performant single-page applications. Experienced in building customer-facing web products using Vue, Nuxt.js and modern JavaScript, with production deployments on Linux environments and cross-team delivery at scale.

Technical Skills
Vue, JavaScript, Nuxt.js, Linux

- Deployed CI/CD pipelines for Nuxt.js applications on Linux servers, automating rollbacks and decreasing release incidents by introducing automated JavaScript linting and test runs.

Frontend Developer, UrbanPantry (Oct 2021 - Feb 2023)
- Built progressive Nuxt.js storefront with server-side rendering that raised conversion rate by 18% and reduced time-to-interactive via lazy-loaded Vue components.
- Collaborated with backend teams to design API contracts and implemented efficient state management in JavaScript to support real-time cart updates across devices.
- Maintained production deployments on Linux, setting up monitoring dashboards and fast rollback strategies for Nuxt.js releases.

Frontend Developer, Ola (Sep 2021 - Sep 2021)
- Contributed to a short-cycle Nuxt.js pilot for a regional product, implementing client-side routing improvements and JavaScript optimizations that cut perceived latency by 25%.
- Integrated Vue components with existing services and assisted in benchmarking runs on Linux test environments to validate performance targets.

Frontend Developer, PhonePe (Sep 2016 - Aug 2021)
- Developed high-traffic payment flows using Nuxt.js and JavaScript, focusing on reliability and quick client-side validations to minimize failed transactions.
- Introduced modular Vue component patterns and client-side caching strategies that improved responsiveness under load and simplified cross-team reuse.
- Managed build and deployment processes on Linux-based CI systems, reducing build times and improving deployment stability.
